title: rosa coriifolia f. cinerea
intro: Rosa coriifolia f. cinerea, commonly known as Himalayan rose, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, making it beneficial for various health conditions. The health benefits of Rosa coriifolia f. cinerea include relief from pain, fever, and digestive issues, as well as its potential to support the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
